**Finding submitted: deviation (GOVLAW), preferred target.**

- **Governing law:** § 14.3 (p0171) selects New York substantive law — preferred element already met, quoted verbatim.
- **Forum:** No venue or arbitration provision exists anywhere. Targeted searches for "jurisdiction", "venue", "courts" and "arbitration" surfaced only § 8.2 (indemnity damages awarded by a court of competent jurisdiction) and § 14.5 (severability). § 14.4 jury waiver and § 14.14 two-year actions period are procedural and were noted, not double-flagged. § 14.19 concerns geographic delivery scope only.
- Because both preferred and fallback require a named forum, silence is a material shortfall (not walk-away — no foreign venue or foreign-seated arbitration).
- **Redline:** one `insert_after` at p0171 adding exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, subject only to temporary injunctive relief elsewhere; the existing choice-of-law sentence is preserved verbatim.
